title: Applying for a Job: Reading an Advert and Using should / shouldn’t for Expectation
summary: The page presents a job advertisement for security guards and asks students to discuss where such adverts can be found, then study it closely. Grammar focus on using should and shouldn't to express expectations, illustrated through dialogue sentences from a conversation between Samir and Mr Hazem.

title: Joining the Military: Exploring Different Military Jobs and Career Options
summary: The page introduces military careers across three branches — Land Force, Navy and Air Force — and notes the minimum age requirement of 18. It explains that not all roles involve fighting, highlighting technical jobs like computer specialists and non-technical roles such as military drivers, requiring good physical condition.

title: A Robbery at Night: Comparing a Personal Account with a Police Report
summary: The page provides two short texts about the same burglary event: an email from Sue describing her family's reaction and what was stolen, and a police report giving factual details such as the time and address of the crime. Students skim both texts and then complete related exercises.

title: Home Safety: A Police Department Brochure on Protecting Your House from Burglars
summary: The page presents paragraphs from a safety brochure urging the public to secure their homes against theft. It highlights the importance of good windows, doors and locks, warns against planting bushes near windows, and asks students to determine whether the brochure aims to inform, persuade or sell alarms.

title: Road Safety: Listening to a First Driving Lesson and Remembering the Instructor’s Recommendations
summary: The page focuses on road safety through photos of driving rules and a listening activity where Hamzah has his first driving lesson. Students order the photos according to the dialogue and recall the instructor's advice using recommendation phrases such as 'Always remember to…' and 'It's always better to…'.

title: Radar: How Radar Speed Guns Detect Vehicles and Prevent Speeding
summary: The page features a reading text on radar, explaining its invention during World War II, its later use in weather prediction, and how police speed guns send radio waves to calculate a car's speed. Students find a specific number, linking words, vehicle types, and vocabulary for weather conditions.

title: Unit 2 Round Up: Reviewing Rules, Advice, Expectations and Recommendations
summary: The revision page summarizes key language practised in Unit 2: expressing rules with have to, must and need to; giving advice, suggestions and offers; talking about expectations with should and shouldn't; and using recommendation phrases. Students discuss each item with a partner and produce additional examples.

title: Unit 3 Lesson 1 Opening Page
summary: This is a transition page marking the start of Unit 3, Lesson 1 in the student book. It contains only the unit, lesson and page reference information with no substantive content displayed.
